title: Edit certification details

html:
🔥 Product Overview

Why do we support partners editing the certification details？

Currently, the partner is required to provide certification details to join TTSPC. Once the platform has reviewed and approved certification details, these certification details cannot be changed. However, there may be instances where a partner needs to update their certification details, such as their name, logo, etc. To streamline this process and improve partners' experience, we are now automating this process and offering partners the capability to edit certification details directly on TTSPC.

⭐️ Feature introduction

Step 1 Precondition and entrance of editing certification

You can go to My Account➤Profile➤ My category to view the certification details for each category. For approved certifications, partners can click the "edit" to go to the editing page. Precondition of editing

  1. Only Approved certification details can be edited, which excludes the following scenario
    1. When the partner delivers certification details, it is still under review
    2. When the partner delivers editing certification details, it's still under review

*Uneditable situation demo

Description Demo
1 If the certification information is under review, the editing entry will be grey out
2 If the current cert has been approved, but some files are delivered editing requests and haven't been approved

Step 3 Edit certification details and submit

You can edit the files according to your needs and click "Submit" to trigger the review process. Please note:

  1. There are certain sensitive files related to the entity that cannot be changed, including the company's legal name, registration date, business documents, business owner information, etc.
  2. Editing and resubmitting these files will not affect the existing certification information unless it has been approved.

Step 3 Check the review status

After submitting, the Partner can check the status of the editing under each category:

Status Status Description Demo
Approved Editing is approved, and the edited certification details will come into effect and replace the previous ones.
Under review Editing is still under review. A partner can not edit again until it's approved/ rejected
Not approved Editing is rejected, a partner can click edit to modify and submit again

FAQ

Q1: Why can't I modify some information？ Entity information is sensitive and unique information at the company level that cannot be changed, including the company's legal name, registration date, business documents, business owner information, etc.
